test_title: PYST 13: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
E, F, G, H, K, L and N are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) .

G sits third to the left of K. N sits second to the left of H. Only K sits between L and N. F is not an immediate neighbour of G.

How many people sit between E and N when counted from the right of E?
solution:
Given:

E, F, G, H, K, L and N are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

G sits third to the left of K.

Only K sits between L and N.

N sits second to the left of H.

F is not an immediate neighbour of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ac03f9d0b6b35e35f18d16b95169356ee7db05832618daab967afc934868c04.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa3a633585fb39eb0d0474b80c3580092c6f47e7ef9516feae4c16527eb22493.png] 

Thus, two people sit between E and N when counted from the right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
